acceptance_criteria: LDAP settings is not just 10 empty boxes
Custom RBAC screen is not read-only

baseline.what_exists: Terrible UI for DirectorySettingsPanel and CustomRolesPanel

report.objective: Refactor DirectorySettingsPanel to a proper form instead of empty boxes. Refactor CustomRolesPanel so it is not read-only and users can select permissions.
requirements: Refactor DirectorySettingsPanel and CustomRolesPanel frontend React code to be usable and functional.

completed: Replaced the LDAP empty-field layout with a sectioned Material 3 form, explicit LDAP/LDAPS selection, validation, and save feedback.
Added a custom-role creation dialog with selectable permission checkboxes and wired it to the existing role create endpoint.
Corrected the shared audit-log client route to /audit-logs, which matches the gated controller route.

effects.ui: LDAP, custom-role creation, and audit-log client routing updated.

integration.merge_decision: PO controlled; no commit, push, or PR created.

next.objective: Freeze and implement permission persistence and evaluation for custom RBAC roles.

preserved: Existing LDAP API and role API contracts

recommended_reasoning.reason: Permission storage and authorization semantics require a frozen security contract.

unresolved_risks: The current role backend accepts the permission selection but has no frozen persistence/evaluation contract for rbac_role_permissions; selected permissions must not be interpreted as effective authorization until that separate backend movement ships.
